functions.name: update-message
functions.description: Partially update an existing message's text or app-authored rich content, attachments, or remove its quote.

text.description: Replacement ordinary Unicode text, empty to clear.

cards.description: Complete replacement cardsV2 UI objects; [] clears.

items.description: A complete cardsV2 UI object.

attachments.description: Complete replacement attachment references; [] removes attachments.

resourceName.description: Google upload attachmentDataRef.resourceName from an authorized attachment upload result.

attachmentUploadToken.description: Upload token returned with the attachment reference, if required.

items.description: An authorized Google attachment upload reference.

removeQuote.description: Remove existing quotedMessageMetadata; cannot add or replace a quote during update.

accessoryWidgets.description: Complete replacement widget UI objects; [] clears.

items.description: A complete accessory widget UI object.

changes.description: Partial content modifications; no nulls. Empty strings/arrays clear selected content.

messageId.description: Existing message resource name, including supported client-assigned alias.

FunctionInput_google_chat_updatemessage.description: An existing Google Chat message and the content fields to replace or clear.

text.description: Text returned after modification, if available.

updatedAt.description: Last edit instant in UTC if Google supplies it.

FunctionOutput_google_chat_updatemessage.description: The updated Google Chat message identity and available text and edit instant.

tags.instructions: Get messageId from reads or send results. Omitted changes remain unchanged; empty arrays explicitly clear attachments/cards/widgets, and empty text clears text if the resulting message remains valid. Apps may update only their own messages. Rich cards/widgets require app authentication. Use `upsert-message` only for create-or-update by a client-assigned ID.

functions.name: update-section
functions.description: Change the display name of a connected user's custom section without changing its contents or ordering.

sectionId.description: Full identifier of a custom section belonging to the connected user.

sortOrder.description: Returned ordering value, lower values appearing earlier.

displayName.description: Resulting display name, when returned.

FunctionOutput_google_chat_updatesection.description: The updated section with the fields returned by Google Chat.

tags.instructions: Get sectionId from `list-sections`. Only custom sections can be renamed. Use `move-section` to change ordering and `move-section-item` to change contents. This overwrites the current name but does not delete conversations.

functions.name: update-space
functions.description: Partially update a space's name, description, guidelines, history, access audience, permissions, or convert a group chat into a named space.

spaceId.description: Full space resource name.

guidelines.description: New rules; empty string clears them.

description.description: New purpose; empty string clears it.

displayName.description: New named-space name.

permissions.description: Complete replacement permission configuration, keyed by action; inspect current settings first.

membersAllowed.description: Allow ordinary members to perform this action.

managersAllowed.description: Allow space owners to perform this action.

assistantManagersAllowed.description: Allow assistant managers to perform this action.

additionalProperties.description: Role grants for this permission action.

convertToNamedSpace.description: Convert a GROUP_CHAT to SPACE; requires displayName.

changes.description: Partial modifications. Omission preserves existing values; null is allowed only to clear audienceId.

FunctionInput_google_chat_updatespace.description: Identify a Google Chat space and supply only the settings to change.

FunctionOutput_google_chat_updatespace.description: The updated Google Chat space identity, name, and type returned by Google.

tags.instructions: Use `get-space` first to inspect current settings. Supply only changes; omitted fields are preserved. Updating permissions replaces that permission configuration. Converting a group chat requires a nonempty displayName. Administrative connections have a restricted set of editable fields; audience changes require user authentication. This can change who may access or act in a space.

functions.name: update-space-read-state
functions.description: Set the connected user's top-level last-read position in a space, allowing the space to appear read or unread without changing thread reply positions.

spaceId.description: Full identifier of the space whose top-level read boundary is changed.

lastReadAt.description: Requested read-position instant with explicit UTC marker or numeric offset, up to nanosecond precision. It may move forward or backward; null/empty does not clear the field.

FunctionInput_google_chat_updatespacerea.description: The space and requested instant for the connected user's top-level read boundary.

spaceId.description: Full identifier of the related space.

FunctionOutput_google_chat_updatespacere.description: The personal space read state returned by Chat after updating the read boundary.

tags.instructions: Use this to set your connected user's top-level read boundary. A position before the newest top-level message makes the space unread; a later position marks it read and is coerced by Chat to the latest message time. Thread replies are unaffected. Use `get-space-read-state` to inspect the resulting position and `get-thread-read-state` for thread reply positions.

functions.name: update-user-availability-state
functions.description: Change the connected user's presence to active, away, or do-not-disturb, optionally expiring active or do-not-disturb after a duration or at an instant.

state.description: Presence state to apply to the connected user; IDLE cannot be set explicitly.

expiresAt.description: Absolute state expiration with explicit offset and up to nanosecond precision; unsupported for AWAY and exclusive with durationSeconds.

durationSeconds.description: Whole seconds until ACTIVE or DO_NOT_DISTURB expires; unsupported for AWAY and exclusive with expiresAt.

FunctionInput_google_chat_updateuseravai.description: Presence state and optional expiration to apply to the connected user.

state.description: Current state returned by Chat after the change, if supplied.

expiresAt.description: Status expiration in UTC Z, if provided.

doNotDisturbExpiresAt.description: DND expiration in UTC Z, when returned; not inferred from an input TTL.

FunctionOutput_google_chat_updateuserava.description: Availability returned by Google Chat after the presence change.

tags.instructions: Use this for presence state, not custom status text; use `update-user-custom-status` for that. Away is unaffected by user activity. Active normally expires to away, but continued activity can extend it. Do-not-disturb typically suppresses notifications until expiration. Use `get-user-availability` to inspect the result before replaying an ambiguous change.

durationSeconds.description: Whole seconds from the provider's current time until the status expires; mutually exclusive with expiresAt.

FunctionOutput_google_chat_updateusercus.description: Availability returned by Chat after updating only the custom status.

tags.instructions: Use this for your connected user's status text and Unicode emoji. This replaces the entire custom status; omitted expiry uses Chat's default behavior. Use `update-user-availability-state` to change presence instead. Pass customStatus:null to clear the custom status, not an empty text value.

functions.name: upload-attachment
functions.description: Upload exact file bytes into a Chat space and return the attachment reference needed to attach them to a message. This tool accepts files up to 10 MiB and does not itself send a message.

spaceId.description: Full resource name of the destination Chat space, spaces/{space}; the upload reference is for this space.

filename.description: Attachment filename including its extension, as ordinary Unicode text.

contentType.description: MIME media type of the exact bytes, such as application/pdf; used for the binary upload, without parameters.

contentBase64.description: Standard padded base64 of a nonempty file, not a data URL. Decoded bytes must not exceed 10485760 bytes (10 MiB), a public tool bound below Google's documented 200 MB upload ceiling.

FunctionInput_google_chat_uploadattachme.description: Destination space, Unicode filename, MIME type, and exact file bytes encoded as standard padded base64.

spaceId.description: Destination space resource name supplied to the upload.

filename.description: Filename supplied for the uploaded bytes, preserved as Unicode text.

resourceName.description: Opaque attachment data resource name accepted by download-media; omitted if not returned.

attachmentUploadToken.description: Opaque token used to create or update messages with this attachment; omitted if not returned. Do not parse or modify it.

FunctionOutput_google_chat_uploadattachm.description: Uploaded attachment reference for the destination space; no message has been sent.

tags.instructions: Use this to prepare an attachment for a message. Obtain the destination space's resource ID from a space lookup and supply the file's exact bytes as base64. This call uploads at most 10 MiB and does not send or update a message. Pass the returned attachmentDataRef to the message creation or update task. If resourceName is returned, `download-media` can retrieve its bytes. Do not assume an upload is safe to repeat after an uncertain result.

functions.name: upsert-message
functions.description: Create or update message text using a client-assigned message ID scoped to one space.
